fact: NRA Commissioner General Jeneba Bangura said that through the Integrated Tax Administration System (ITAS) taxpayers can now file returns electronically.
NRA Commissioner General Jeneba Bangura said that through ITAS taxpayers can pay electronically, and that wallet money and mobile money now allow payments to be made electronically.

The Fair Tax Monitor study says the Integrated Tax Administration System (ITAS), promised in budget speeches from 2015, only saw implementation in 2019 and was still ongoing, with its user acceptance test delayed by the pandemic; as_of is the study's published date.
